description: This file defines an abstract class 'GatekeeperStorage' for secure data storage tailored to Gatekeeper's needs, including methods for allocating, checking keys, reading, and writing binary blobs. It includes external dependencies on JSON and TPM types.

classes.name: GatekeeperStorage
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for secure storage of binary blobs, with methods for allocation, key existence check, reading, and writing data.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates storage for a given key with specified size.

methods.name: HasKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in storage.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data associated with a key, returning a TPM2B_MAX_NV_BUFFER pointer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data associated with a key into storage.
